item.title: Soulja Boy Claims He Was the First Rapper to Drop 3 Projects on the Same Day, Not Drake
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: Welcome to "Trending Now", the podcast where we dive into the latest news in music. I'm your host, [Name]. Today, we're talking about Soulja Boy's latest claim to fame.
[Short music transition]
Host: So, you might've heard that Drake just dropped not one, not two, but three new albums on the same day. Well, Soulja Boy is saying he was the first to do it, back in 2009. He released three mixtapes on Halloween, and he's not afraid to remind everyone about it.
[Clip of Soulja Boy's quote: "I was the first rapper to drop three projects in the same day. Btw"]
Host: But, fans weren't having it, and they quickly pointed out that they don't remember much from those mixtapes. And, to make matters worse, an X Community Note fact-checked Soulja Boy, saying that Gucci Mane actually did it first, two weeks prior, with his Cold War series.
[Short music transition]
Host: Now, you might be wondering why Soulja Boy is so invested in one-upping Drake. Well, it's no secret that the two have a history. They collaborated on "We Made It" back in 2014, and Soulja Boy has even admitted to trolling Drake in the past. It all stems back to Drake interpolating his "What's Hannenin" track on "Miss Me" in 2010.
[Clip of Soulja Boy's quote: "I just think it's funnier 'cause it's like you stole my s–t, so now I can just troll you"]
Host: So, there you have it. Soulja Boy's claim to fame might not be as solid as he thought, but it's definitely sparked some interesting conversation. Thanks for tuning in to "Trending Now". Join us next time for more music news and updates.
[Outro music plays]
